run_interactive_robot_play: run the interactive robot play script with pygame controls for arm and base movement
run_play_no_render: run the interactive play script in headless mode with the --no-render flag enabled
run_play_save_observations: run the interactive play script and save rendered observations as a video file
run_play_load_actions: run the interactive play script loading pre-recorded arm actions from a numpy file
run_play_with_ik_config: run the interactive play script with IK control using a custom YAML config file
